in_marathi.name: Chandru
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chandru हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chandru is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Chandra', which means 'Moon'. In Hindu mythology, Chandru is the name of the Moon God. He is also known as Soma and is considered the god of the night and the ruler of the stars.
